title: EasyControlEdge: A Foundation-Model Fine-Tuning For Edge Detection
mechanism: Lightweight condition injection on a frozen FLUX.1-dev rectified-flow model, pixel-space weighted CE through a proxy gradient, guidance scale controls edge density at inference.
adaptation: EL replicated to 3 channels at 512 px, frozen backbone, crack-only target; guidance scale as a recall knob for E1 and the almost-all-cracks target. Gated FLUX download needs user OK. First check VAE reconstruction of GT crack maps since the 8x latent may erase 1 px cracks.
min_experiment: Step 1: crack IoU of decode(encode(GT)) vs GT on train cells; stop if < 0.8. Step 2: 1 seed on 478 cells, judged on E1 crack relF1@2 vs PF single model and PF ensemble (0.43 to 0.47). Kill if below PF single model. About 40 GPU-h.
evidence: R: BIPED with 20 training images CEval ODS 0.875 vs DiffusionEdge 0.851, GED 0.746; BSDS CEval ODS 0.807; CubiCasa walls strong at 42 images.
prior_overlap: None; generative foundation models and adapters are listed as open. Frozen linear probes of DINO/SAM do not cover this.

alt_notes.adaptation: Tile the EL image to 3 channels at 512 px and train LoRA only, on crack. The guidance scale acts as a recall knob that is not a threshold, aimed at the target relR@2 >= 0.90 at relP@2 >= 0.90 and at E1.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: EasyControlEdge LoRA on crack, 3 seeds. Baseline: house ensemble. Metrics: best relR@2 at relP@2 >= 0.90, E1 relF1@2. Kill if both are below the house model.
